text: I started off, as amongst the first doctors in India, to early test a new app. The journey was very rocky , but the app developers slowly improved on their mistakes and errors. The current version of the app which we use is very different from the one on which I started. But what I must compliment is the excellent customer service interaction of the developing company. One person, Freya stood out, Give the app a try. It is the future. Though still a lot of development has to go into it
